identitySignals: Agenda text names a donor-advised fund held at Fidelity Charitable. The fund is called the Taylor Charitable Foundation. Fidelity Charitable is a real nonprofit, the Fidelity Investments Charitable Gift Fund, EIN 11-0303001, in Boston, MA.
The agenda gives Oakland, CA. That doesn't match Fidelity Charitable's Boston headquarters. It likely refers to the school or the donor.

A search for 'Taylor Charitable Foundation' in Oakland found no matching organization. It only returned unrelated Oakland nonprofits, such as the Sammy R Taylor Foundation and the Sam Taylor Foundation.
research.notes: The agenda describes a donation made through a donor-advised fund. The 'Taylor Charitable Foundation' appears to be a donor's named fund, not a standalone registered organization. The real donor may be a private person or family, so I did not research further. The only registered legal entity is Fidelity Charitable (Fidelity Investments Charitable Gift Fund, Boston, MA, EIN 11-0303001), the fund's sponsor. It is not clearly the vendor OUSD means, and its location doesn't match Oakland. I did not publish a profile because attaching Fidelity Charitable's website, phone or address to this entry could be wrong. A reviewer should decide whether to list this as Fidelity Charitable.
